info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Hauyne Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Hauyne Battery Details Management API provides a streamlined way to manage battery details within the Hauyne catalog. It enables businesses to add detailed specifications, attributes, and descriptions associated with Hauyne batteries. This API is primarily used by developers and integrators who need to maintain up-to-date battery information for inventory, sales, or production purposes. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their product offerings and ensure comprehensive data is available for customer inquiries and operational needs.

post.summary: Create new details for Hauyne battery.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details related to the Hauyne battery. Upon submission, it processes the provided information and stores it in the database, ensuring that all necessary validations are performed to maintain data integrity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details about the Hauyne battery for processing. It contains necessary fields required for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning battery details.
